repositories.readme:
# AirCard 🎴 > **Apple Wallet Card Skinner & Lockscreen Passcode Themer (No Jailbreak Required)** > **Supports iOS 18.0 – 27.0.1 & iOS 27.2 beta 1–2** (iOS 27.2 beta 3+ patched) > Powered by the `airlift` AirTraffic sync exploit.

--- ## Compatibility | iOS Version | Status | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **iOS 18.0 – 27.0.1** | ✅ Supported | Full support for Wallet skins and Lockscreen passcode themes | | **iOS 27.2 beta 1 – beta 2** | ✅ Supported | Working | | **iOS 27.2 beta 3+** | ❌ Patched | Apple patched the underlying `airlift` exploit. Flashing will not work. | > [!IMPORTANT] > Do not update to **iOS 27.2 beta 3 or newer** if you want to continue using AirCard. The underlying AirTraffic sync exploit was patched by Apple in beta 3. --- ## Features - 🎨 **Custom Card Skins:** Assign custom artwork, textures, or bank logos to Apple Pay and Wallet cards. - 🔢 **Lock Screen Passcode Themes (.passthm):** Apply custom keypad button artwork from popular `.passthm` themes directly to iOS 18+ lockscreen. - 🧩 **Passcode Theme Creator:** Create custom themes from a single wallpaper (Seamless Poster Slicing) or build key-by-key (Individual Keys). - 🔍 **Interactive Photo Framing:** Pan and zoom artwork directly inside keypad buttons with real-time iPhone preview. - ✏️ **Edit Existing .passthm Themes:** Open any Cowabunga or Nugget theme package directly in the creator, tweak button artwork, reposition photos, and re-export or flash. - ⚡ **Per-Card & Bulk Customization:** Set unique artwork for each card or apply one design across all cards with a single click. - 📱 **Zero-Hassle Card Detection:** Tap any card in your iPhone's Wallet app to detect its hash in real-time. - 🚀 **100% Standalone (Universal):** Native support for both **Apple Silicon** and **Intel (x86)** Macs. All required device-communication utilities and image engines are pre-bundled inside the app. - 📦 **Zero Prerequisites:** No Homebrew, Python packages, or terminal setup required for macOS users. --- ## Guides and sample artwork Wallet setup, detailed troubleshooting, multi-card workflows, theme creation, compatibility reporting, and local artwork preparation: - [简体中文使用指南](docs/guides/README.zh-CN.md) - [English getting-started guide](docs/guides/README.en.md) - [Card artwork and source notes](assets/skins/README.md) - [Offline card artwork editor](tools/card-artwork/README.md) — download a single HTML file, frame an image locally, and export a 1536 × 969 PNG --- ## Installation ### macOS (Universal DMG) 1. Download **`AirCard.dmg`** from [Releases](https://github.com/mak5er/AirCard/releases). 2. Open `AirCard.dmg` and drag **`AirCard.app`** into your **Applications** folder. 3. Fully compatible with both **Apple Silicon** and **Intel (x86)** Macs. > [!NOTE] > **First Launch on macOS (Gatekeeper):** > If macOS displays an unidentified developer prompt on first launch: > - **Method 1 (UI):** Right-click (or Control-click) `AirCard.app` in Applications ➔ click **Open** ➔ click **Open**. > - **Method 2 (Terminal):** > ```sh > sudo xattr -cr /Applications/AirCard.app > ``` > [!TIP] > **macOS Developer Tools / Python Requirement:** > AirCard uses macOS native Python 3 (`/usr/bin/python3`). If macOS prompts that Developer Tools are required or if you recently installed/updated Xcode: > - Install Command Line Tools: `xcode-select --install` > - Accept Xcode license if applicable: `sudo xcodebuild -license accept` > [!NOTE] > **Windows users:** an unofficial Windows port is available at [**AirCard-Windows**](https://github.com/Lumid-Off/AirCard-Windows). --- ## How to Customize Apple Wallet Cards 1. Connect your iPhone to your Mac via USB cable and ensure it is unlocked and trusted. 2. In AirCard, stay on the **Wallet Cards** tab and click **Scan Cards**. 3. On your iPhone: - **Double-click the Side (Power) button** to open Apple Pay. - Authenticate with **Face ID**. - **Tap your card** (or tap it once more) to trigger instant detection! 4. Click on any card mockup or drag & drop an image directly onto the card. 5. Click **Flash Skins**. 6. Force-close the **Wallet** app on your iPhone from the App Switcher (or reboot) to see your new custom card design! > [!NOTE] > **Apple Card:** > The Apple Card (titanium/digital card) uses dynamic vector rendering based on your spending categories instead of static cached card skins. Custom skins apply to standard debit/credit cards, transit cards, and passes. ### Card names and missing-card checks Scanned cards can now display names from this Mac's Wallet cache. Open **Check missing cards** to distinguish current-scan matches from membership entries and payment caches that still need confirmation. Use **Reconnect** for connection problems and **Read Cache** to reread local metadata. For payment cards, AirCard uses the NFC activation event for the card you actually open. Wallet may also request artwork for several cards; IDs observed in those current iPhone log paths can appear in a batch. Once a live ID matches one specific remote-device cache, the remaining payment IDs from that same cache are included so cards omitted by iOS logging still appear. Saved IDs from an earlier run remain hidden until the current scan matches them again. Cards and skin file paths are saved by ID separately for each iPhone, in stable local discovery order. Only IDs matched during the current scan, either live or through the live-ID-matched device cache, are shown or eligible to flash; saved records only restore their skin after revalidation. Cache counts are not the phone's total, and phone Wallet order is not synchronized. See [card identification and diagnostics](docs/wallet-discovery.md). ### If scanning finds no cards The scanner uses the iPhone's unified log service, including Info/Debug events. On iOS 18.6.2, the legacy log service can show Wallet activity while omitting the resource lookup messages that contain card identifiers. Open **Log** and check for `Connected to the unified device log stream`, then double-click the side button, authenticate, and tap or switch cards. If the log reader stops, reconnect and unlock the iPhone, then start another scan. Values that iOS replaces with `` cannot be recovered by the scanner. If your device previously connected but scanning found zero cards, please try this build and report whether it helps. Include your iPhone model, iOS version, macOS version, and the AirCard version or commit tested. Avoid posting full device logs or card identifiers. See [scanner validation](docs/wallet-card-detection.md) for the verified environment and remaining coverage. --- ## How to Apply Lockscreen Passcode Themes (.passthm) 1. Switch to the **Passcode Themes** tab at the top of AirCard. 2. Drag & drop any `.passthm` file into the app (or click **Choose .passthm File**). 3. AirCard will inspect the theme and display an interactive preview on the numeric keypad (0–9, *, #). 4. Click **Apply Passcode Theme**. 5. Restart your iPhone to reload the lock screen cache and see your custom passcode buttons! > [!TIP] > **Universal Language & Bold Text Support:** > AirCard automatically expands and flashes custom keypad assets for all system locales (English, Ukrainian, Russian, Spanish, German, French, etc.) and generates both standard and **Bold Text** cache bitmaps (`--white` and `--white-bold`), ensuring your theme works regardless of your iOS language or accessibility display settings! --- ## Community Resources - [AirCards](https://aircards.org/) — A free, independently maintained card artwork catalog and sharing community. Browse, filter, and preview designs, download PNG artwork to use with AirCard, or publish your own creations for others to discover and use. These resources are maintained by the community and are not affiliated with the AirCard project. --- ## Building from Source ```sh git clone https://github.com/mak5er/AirCard.git cd AirCard chmod +x build.sh ./build.sh ``` This builds universal binaries (`arm64` + `x86_64`), bundles dependencies into `build/AirCard.app`, and outputs `build/AirCard.dmg`. --- ## Contributors - **[@mak5er](https://github.com/mak5er)** (Developer) — [GitHub](https://github.com/mak5er) · [Twitter / X](https://x.com/mak5er) - **[@Lumid-Off](https://github.com/Lumid-Off)** (Contributor & Developer) — [GitHub](https://github.com/Lumid-Off) · [Twitter / X](https://x.com/LumidOff) - **[AirLift](https://github.com/0xjohnnydev/airlift)** by **[0xjohnny (@0xjohnnydev)](https://github.com/0xjohnnydev)**: Original AirTraffic/ATAirlock sandbox escape and proof of concept underlying `AirliftFFI`. ## Credits - Core exploit based on `airlift` (AirTraffic sync escape). --- ## Support If you find AirCard useful, you can support future development: - **PayPal**: [Donate via PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=98QRTC2HFRA4Y) - **TON**: `UQBm9KPhtMw-XVVjirUoa09wzrlyWsbeZhKfefl1Uw-qNZ-r` - **USDT (TRC20)**: `TDkDMCyjYxgvkWUnQiF5Erk2RyPQMT6G1n` - **USDT / BNB (BEP20)**: `0x0954dc491c502849d04956ef74634aa5931a08e8`

# MLM VPN — Android

A multi-engine VPN, network scanner and serverless messenger for Android.
Developed and maintained by mlmvpn.

English · فارسی · Русский · 中文


Home
Settings
WireGuard
Gereh
Cloud
--- ## Source code · سورس کد **English.** This repository holds the full source of the app and of Gereh, the messenger inside it: | Folder | What it is | |---|---| | `app/` | The VPN app | | `mlm-chat/` | Gereh's core in Rust (identity, Olm/Megolm end-to-end encryption, groups and channels, transports), its Android package, the protocol (`mlm-chat/docs/SPEC.md`) and the relays' code (`mlm-chat/relay/`) | | `chat/` | Gereh's interface, a fork of Telegram for Android (GPL) | What the app itself sends to us is all in the code: crash reports (`app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/scanner/crash/`), the Quick Connect pool (`app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/scanner/quick/MlmPoolClient.kt`) and Game Booster statistics (`app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/scanner/engines/game/booster/crowd/`). Before publishing, the addresses and keys of our own servers and relays were replaced with placeholders (`203.0.113.x`, `*.redacted.invalid`, `redacted-…`) to protect them from attacks. Prebuilt binaries (`.so`, `.aar`, `.dat`) are not in this repository; they are inside each release's APK. **فارسی.** این مخزن سورس کامل برنامه و «گره»، پیام‌رسان داخل آن، را دارد: | پوشه | چیست | |---|---| | `app/` | برنامهٔ VPN | | `mlm-chat/` | هستهٔ گره به زبان Rust (هویت، رمزنگاری سرتاسری Olm/Megolm، گروه و کانال، راه‌های رساندن پیام)، بستهٔ اندروید آن، قرارداد پروتکل (`mlm-chat/docs/SPEC.md`) و کد رله‌ها (`mlm-chat/relay/`) | | `chat/` | رابط گره، فورک تلگرام اندروید (GPL) | هرچه خود برنامه برای ما می‌فرستد همه در کد پیداست: گزارش خطا (`app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/scanner/crash/`)، استخر اتصال سریع (`app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/scanner/quick/MlmPoolClient.kt`) و آمار گیم بوستر (`app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/scanner/engines/game/booster/crowd/`). پیش از انتشار، آدرس و کلید سرورها و رله‌های خودمان با جای‌نگهدار (`203.0.113.x`، `*.redacted.invalid`، `redacted-…`) عوض شده تا از حمله در امان بمانند. فایل‌های ازپیش‌ساخته (`.so`، `.aar`، `.dat`) در این مخزن نیستند و داخل APK هر نسخه هستند. ## English ### Overview MLM VPN brings many independent connection engines together behind one iPhone-style home screen: a V2Ray/Xray client and clean-IP scanner, adaptive engines that find a working route by themselves, more than twenty connection methods for restrictive networks, a full Cloudflare control panel, and **Gereh**, a messenger that works with no server at all. It is written in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (`minSdk 24`, `targetSdk 34`, `compileSdk 36`). > ⚠️ This project involves network circumvention and VPN technology. Use it > in compliance with the laws of your jurisdiction. The maintainers do not > encourage or condone illegal use. ### Languages English, فارسی, **Русский** and **中文** (Russian and Chinese are new in 1.2.43: menus, buttons and messages are translated; part of the text inside some pages is still in English). Choose one in Settings › App Language; Gereh follows it. ### Gereh — a phone-to-phone messenger (new in 1.2.43) - **No server, no phone number, no email.** Your identity is a key made on the phone, with a name like `ehsan·4821`; messages go straight from phone to phone. - **End-to-end encrypted.** Every message, photo and file is sealed on the sender's phone and opened only on the receiver's. - **Many ways to deliver:** a shared Wi-Fi even with no internet, Bluetooth when you are close, the internet through volunteers (users' own phones and computers), and the **Google relay** — a small mailbox (Apps Script) in the user's own Google account for phones that cannot reach each other, such as one on Irancell and one on MCI. Owners can open their relay to everyone as a **public relay**; Google and the owner see only sealed bytes. - **Files in pieces:** photos, videos, files and voice messages are cut into equal parts so they get through any route, including the relay. - **Groups and channels** with an owner and admins, settings and member rights, invite links (with or without approval), and the official channel and group «MLMVPN Official» with a member count estimated phone to phone. - Add contacts by QR or card link, or «add nearby» with a 4-symbol check. Notifications, chat folders and a home-screen widget; Gereh runs in its own process so its errors never touch the VPN. ### Connection engines - **FLUX** — an adaptive engine of its own: races many routes, lets you choose the country and IP version, and proves the real exit after connecting. - **MAE (MLM Adaptive Engine)** — you pick your apps and sites; it learns, per network, which route each one needs and builds foreign exits (a US exit for Gemini and Google Flow) on your own Cloudflare account. - **V2Ray / Xray client** — VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks with REALITY, TLS, WebSocket, gRPC and XHTTP; subscriptions, batch tests and a two-stage clean-IP scanner. - **WARP, MASQUE, WireGuard and WARP-in-WARP** (Aether core) with an exit country of your choice over NAT64, and a standalone **WARP** engine. - **Amnezia** — free AmneziaWG, WireGuard and Hysteria2 servers, also carried through Cloudflare where the line blocks them. - **FENIX** — Firefox's free VPN on your own Firefox accounts (33 countries, 50 GB a month per account). - **Proton VPN** and **Windscribe** free servers on your own accounts (every protocol, through WARP where the provider is blocked), **Outline** keys, **OpenVPN** (TunnelBear and free `.ovpn` files) and **NPV** configs. - **Psiphon**, **Tor** (with a bridge manager that tests bridges from your line), **Geph**, **Lantern** and **URnetwork**. - **GitHub Tunnel** — your own cloud server on your GitHub account's free allowance; **Telegram Proxy** on your own Cloudflare; **Quick Connect**, Iran configs, the SNI anti-filter (with ECH) and server-less domain fronting. ### Cloud and tools - **Cloud panel** — connect Cloudflare accounts, deploy self-hosted Worker panels in one tap, fetch their configs and watch daily usage. - **Cloudflare Doctor** — finds where your connection to Cloudflare breaks, trying dozens of ways on your own line, and remembers what works per network. - **Config Studio** — a panel for users, volume, time and device limits on your own Worker, with multi-location exits, plans, templates and endpoints. - **MLM Scout** — tests every method on your line for real and ranks them. - **Game Booster** — measures the route to the game's region and picks the best of your own line, WARP, Amnezia, WireGuard and FENIX; anti-sanction DNS for sign-in and a floating ping over the game. - **Smart Iran routing**, per-app split tunnelling and **local network sharing** (proxy, hotspot and PAC link for other devices) on every engine. - iPhone-style home screen with folders and search, home-screen widgets and **Widget Studio**, a Quick Settings tile, an engine **store** with signed updates, backup and restore, and in-app software updates. ### Project structure ``` app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/ ├── core/ # Low-level engine wrappers (aether, warp, tunnel) └── scanner/ ├── data/ # Node/subscription/cloud data managers ├── engines/ # Pluggable connectivity engines (one dir each) ├── mitm/ # On-device CA + server-less domain-fronting profile ├── ui/ # Compose screens └── utils/ # Config generators, testers, watchdogs app/src/main/assets/ # Bundled worker scripts, geo data, sanction lists app/src/main/jniLibs/ # Prebuilt native libraries (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a) ``` ### Building Requirements: Android Studio (recent), a JDK matching the Android Gradle Plugin in `build.gradle`, and the Android SDK with `compileSdk 36`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git cd mlmvpn_android ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` The debug APK is written to `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/`. > Native libraries (`.so` files under `app/src/main/jniLibs/`) and data files > (`geoip.dat`, `geosite.dat`) are large and tracked with **Git LFS**. Install > [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.com/) and run `git lfs pull` after cloning if those > files show up as small pointer files. ### Changelog See [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) for the full version history (bilingual), or the [**changelog page**](https://mlmvpn.github.io/mlmvpn_android/changelog.html). ### Contributing Contributions are welcome — see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the project structure, coding conventions, and how to add a new engine. ### License & Attribution This project is licensed under **GNU GPLv3**, plus an additional term (permitted under GPLv3 §7) requiring attribution — see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). The project includes GPL source (`kittoku/mvc`, `shadowsocks-android`, and Telegram for Android for Gereh's interface), so the whole combined work is GPL. In short: > Any use, fork, or derivative of this project — source or compiled — must > clearly credit the original developer, **mlmvpn** > (https://github.com/mlmvpn), wherever the software is presented to end > users (About screen, README, store listing, etc.), in addition to the > standard GPLv3 obligations (source availability, same license on > derivatives, etc.). --- ## فارسی ### معرفی **MLM VPN** چندین موتور اتصال مستقل را زیر یک صفحهٔ اصلی به سبک آیفون گرد هم می‌آورد: کلاینت V2Ray/Xray و اسکنر آی‌پی تمیز، موتورهای هوشمندی که خودشان راه کارا را پیدا می‌کنند، بیش از بیست روش اتصال برای شبکه‌های محدود، یک پنل کامل کلادفلر، و **گره**، پیام‌رسانی که هیچ سروری ندارد. با Kotlin و Jetpack Compose نوشته شده است (`minSdk 24`، `targetSdk 34`، `compileSdk 36`). > ⚠️ این پروژه با فناوری VPN و دورزدن محدودیت‌های شبکه سروکار دارد. لطفاً > مطابق قوانین کشور خود از آن استفاده کنید. توسعه‌دهندگان این پروژه استفادهٔ > غیرقانونی را تشویق یا تأیید نمی‌کنند. ### زبان‌ها English، فارسی، **Русский** و **中文** (روسی و چینی در نسخهٔ ۱.۲.۴۳ اضافه شدند: منوها، دکمه‌ها و پیام‌ها ترجمه شده‌اند و بخشی از متن‌های داخل بعضی صفحه‌ها هنوز انگلیسی است). از تنظیمات › زبان اپلیکیشن انتخاب کنید؛ گره هم همان را دنبال می‌کند. ### گره — پیام‌رسان گوشی‌به‌گوشی (تازهٔ نسخهٔ ۱.۲.۴۳) - **بی سرور، بی شمارهٔ تلفن، بی ایمیل.** هویت شما کلیدی است که روی خود گوشی ساخته می‌شود، با نامی مثل `ehsan·4821`؛ پیام مستقیم از گوشی به گوشی می‌رود. - **رمزگذاری سرتاسری.** هر پیام، عکس و فایل روی گوشی فرستنده مهر می‌شود و فقط روی گوشی گیرنده باز می‌شود. - **راه‌های زیاد برای رساندن پیام:** وای‌فای مشترک حتی بی اینترنت، بلوتوث وقتی کنار هم هستید، اینترنت از راه داوطلبان (گوشی‌ها و رایانه‌های خود کاربران)، و **رلهٔ گوگل** — صندوقی کوچک (Apps Script) در حساب گوگل خود کاربر برای وقتی که دو گوشی به هم نمی‌رسند، مثلاً یکی ایرانسل و دیگری همراه اول. صاحب رله می‌تواند آن را به‌صورت **رلهٔ عمومی** برای همه باز کند؛ گوگل و صاحب رله فقط بایت‌های مهرشده می‌بینند. - **تکه‌تکه کردن فایل‌ها:** عکس، ویدیو، فایل و پیام صوتی در تکه‌های هم‌اندازه فرستاده می‌شوند تا از هر راهی، از جمله رله، رد شوند. - **گروه و کانال** با صاحب و مدیران، تنظیمات و اختیارات اعضا، لینک دعوت (با تأیید مدیر یا بی آن)، و کانال و گروه رسمی «MLMVPN رسمی» با شمار اعضایی که گوشی‌به‌گوشی تخمین زده می‌شود. - افزودن مخاطب با QR یا لینک کارت، یا «افزودن از نزدیک» با کد تأیید ۴ نمادی. اعلان، پوشه‌های گفت‌وگو و ویجت صفحهٔ اصلی؛ گره در پروسهٔ جدای خودش اجرا می‌شود تا خطایش به VPN آسیب نزند. ### موتورهای اتصال - **FLUX** — موتور هوشمند مستقل: راه‌های زیادی را هم‌زمان می‌آزماید، کشور و نسخهٔ IP را به انتخاب شما می‌گذارد و پس از اتصال، خروجی واقعی را ثابت می‌کند. - **MAE (موتور تطبیقی MLM)** — برنامه‌ها و سایت‌هایتان را انتخاب می‌کنید؛ برای هر کدام روی هر شبکه یاد می‌گیرد کدام راه لازم است و خروجی خارجی (از جمله خروجی آمریکا برای جمینای و گوگل فلو) را روی حساب کلادفلر خودتان می‌سازد. - **کلاینت V2Ray / Xray** — VLESS، VMess، Trojan و Shadowsocks با REALITY، TLS، WebSocket، gRPC و XHTTP؛ لینک اشتراک، تست گروهی و اسکنر دومرحله‌ای آی‌پی تمیز. - **وارپ، ماسک، وایرگارد و وارپ در وارپ** (هستهٔ Aether) با کشور خروجی دلخواه از راه NAT64، و موتور مستقل **وارپ**. - **آمنزیا** — سرورهای رایگان AmneziaWG، WireGuard و Hysteria2، و جایی که خط آن‌ها را می‌بندد، از راه کلادفلر. - **فنیکس** — VPN رایگان فایرفاکس روی حساب‌های فایرفاکس خودتان (۳۳ کشور، ماهی ۵۰ گیگ برای هر حساب). - سرورهای رایگان **Proton VPN** و **Windscribe** روی حساب خودتان (همهٔ پروتکل‌ها، و از راه وارپ جایی که خودشان بسته‌اند)، کلیدهای **Outline**، **OpenVPN** (TunnelBear و فایل‌های رایگان `.ovpn`) و کانفیگ‌های **NPV**. - **سایفون**، **تور** (با مدیریت پل‌ها که پل‌ها را از خط خودتان می‌آزماید)، **گف**، **لنترن** و **URnetwork**. - **گیت‌هاب تانل** — سرور ابری خودتان روی سهمیهٔ رایگان حساب گیت‌هاب؛ **پروکسی تلگرام** روی کلادفلر خودتان؛ **اتصال سریع**، کانفیگ‌های ایران، ضدفیلتر SNI (با ECH) و دامین‌فرانتینگ بدون سرور. ### ابری و ابزارها - **پنل ابری** — اتصال حساب‌های کلادفلر، استقرار یک‌لمسی پنل‌های ورکر خوداستقرار، دریافت کانفیگ‌هایشان و پایش مصرف روزانه. - **دکتر کلادفلر** — پیدا می‌کند اتصال شما به کلادفلر کجا می‌شکند، با ده‌ها روش روی خط خودتان، و آنچه کار می‌کند را برای هر شبکه به خاطر می‌سپارد. - **کانفیگ استدیو** — پنل کاربر، حجم، زمان و سقف دستگاه روی ورکر خودتان، با خروجی چندکشوری، بسته‌ها، قالب‌ها و نقطه‌های اتصال. - **MLM Scout** — همهٔ روش‌ها را واقعاً روی خط شما می‌آزماید و رتبه‌بندی می‌کند. - **گیم بوستر** — مسیر تا منطقهٔ بازی را اندازه می‌گیرد و بهترین را از میان خط خودتان، وارپ، آمنزیا، وایرگارد و فنیکس برمی‌گزیند؛ DNS ضدتحریم برای ورود و پینگ شناور روی بازی. - **مسیریابی هوشمند ایران**، تونل جداگانه برای هر برنامه و **اشتراک در شبکهٔ محلی** (پروکسی، هات‌اسپات و لینک PAC برای دستگاه‌های دیگر) روی همهٔ موتورها. - صفحهٔ اصلی به سبک آیفون با پوشه و جستجو، ویجت‌های صفحهٔ اصلی و **ویجت استدیو**، کاشی تنظیمات سریع، **استور** موتورها با به‌روزرسانی امضاشده، پشتیبان‌گیری و بازگردانی، و به‌روزرسانی برنامه از داخل خودش. ### ساختار پروژه ``` app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/ ├── core/ # لایه‌های پایهٔ موتورها (aether، warp، tunnel) └── scanner/ ├── data/ # مدیریت دادهٔ نود/اشتراک/کلاود ├── engines/ # موتورهای اتصال (هر کدام یک پوشه) ├── mitm/ # گواهی روی گوشی + پروفایل دامین‌فرانتینگ بدون سرور ├── ui/ # صفحه‌های Compose └── utils/ # تولیدکننده‌های کانفیگ، تسترها، واچ‌داگ‌ها app/src/main/assets/ # اسکریپت‌های ورکر، دادهٔ جغرافیایی، فهرست تحریم app/src/main/jniLibs/ # کتابخانه‌های native از پیش ساخته‌شده ``` ### ساخت پروژه پیش‌نیازها: Android Studio (نسخهٔ اخیر)، JDK متناسب با Android Gradle Plugin در `build.gradle`، و Android SDK با `compileSdk 36`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git cd mlmvpn_android ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` فایل APK دیباگ در `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/` ساخته می‌شود. > کتابخانه‌های native (فایل‌های `.so` در `app/src/main/jniLibs/`) و فایل‌های > داده (`geoip.dat`، `geosite.dat`) حجیم‌اند و با **Git LFS** نگه‌داری می‌شوند. > پس از clone، [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.com/) را نصب و `git lfs pull` را اجرا کنید. ### فهرست تغییرات تاریخچهٔ کامل نسخه‌ها (دوزبانه) در [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) و [**صفحهٔ تغییرات**](https://mlmvpn.github.io/mlmvpn_android/changelog.html) است. ### مشارکت از مشارکت شما استقبال می‌شود — [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) را برای ساختار پروژه، شیوهٔ کدنویسی و افزودن موتور تازه بخوانید. ### مجوز و ذکر منبع این پروژه تحت **GNU GPLv3** به‌همراه یک شرط اضافه (مجاز طبق ماده §۷ خود GPLv3) که ذکر منبع را الزامی می‌کند منتشر شده است — [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) را ببینید. پروژه سورس GPL (`kittoku/mvc`، `shadowsocks-android`، و تلگرام اندروید برای رابط گره) را در خود دارد، پس کل اثر ترکیبی GPL است. به‌طور خلاصه: > هرگونه استفاده، فورک یا اثر مشتق‌شده از این پروژه — چه سورس و چه > کامپایل‌شده — باید هرجا که نرم‌افزار به کاربر نهایی نمایش داده می‌شود (صفحهٔ > درباره، README، صفحهٔ فروشگاه و غیره) به‌طور واضح توسعه‌دهندهٔ اصلی، > **mlmvpn** (https://github.com/mlmvpn)، را ذکر کند؛ افزون بر الزام‌های > معمول GPLv3 (در دسترس بودن سورس، همان مجوز برای آثار مشتق و غیره). --- ## Русский ### Обзор MLM VPN объединяет множество независимых движков подключения на одном главном экране в стиле iPhone: клиент V2Ray/Xray и сканер чистых IP, адаптивные движки, которые сами находят рабочий маршрут, более двадцати способов подключения для сетей с ограничениями, полноценную панель Cloudflare и **Gereh** — мессенджер, которому вообще не нужен сервер. Написан на Kotlin и Jetpack Compose (`minSdk 24`, `targetSdk 34`, `compileSdk 36`). > ⚠️ Проект связан с технологиями VPN и обхода сетевых ограничений. > Используйте его в соответствии с законами вашей страны. Разработчики не > поощряют и не одобряют незаконное использование. ### Языки English, فارسی, **Русский** и **中文** (русский и китайский появились в 1.2.43: переведены меню, кнопки и сообщения; часть текста внутри некоторых страниц пока на английском). Выберите язык в Настройки › Язык приложения; Gereh следует ему. ### Gereh — мессенджер от телефона к телефону (новое в 1.2.43) - **Без сервера, без номера телефона, без email.** Ваша идентичность — ключ, созданный на телефоне, с именем вроде `ehsan·4821`; сообщения идут напрямую с телефона на телефон. - **Сквозное шифрование.** Каждое сообщение, фото и файл запечатываются на телефоне отправителя и открываются только на телефоне получателя. - **Много путей доставки:** общий Wi-Fi даже без интернета, Bluetooth рядом, интернет через волонтёров (телефоны и компьютеры самих пользователей) и **ретранслятор Google** — маленький почтовый ящик (Apps Script) в собственном аккаунте Google пользователя для телефонов, которые не могут связаться напрямую, например в Irancell и MCI. Владелец может открыть свой ретранслятор для всех как **публичный**; Google и владелец видят только запечатанные байты. - **Файлы по частям:** фото, видео, файлы и голосовые сообщения режутся на равные части, чтобы пройти любым путём, включая ретранслятор. - **Группы и каналы** с владельцем и администраторами, настройками и правами участников, ссылки-приглашения (с одобрением или без), официальный канал и группа «MLMVPN Official» с числом участников, оцениваемым от телефона к телефону. - Контакты добавляются по QR-коду или ссылке на карточку либо «рядом» с проверкой по 4 символам. Уведомления, папки чатов и виджет главного экрана; Gereh работает в отдельном процессе, поэтому его ошибки не затрагивают VPN. ### Движки подключения - **FLUX** — собственный адаптивный движок: перебирает множество маршрутов, позволяет выбрать страну и версию IP и проверяет реальный выход после подключения. - **MAE (MLM Adaptive Engine)** — вы выбираете свои приложения и сайты; он узнаёт для каждой сети, какой маршрут нужен каждому, и создаёт зарубежные выходы (в том числе выход в США для Gemini и Google Flow) в вашем аккаунте Cloudflare. - **Клиент V2Ray / Xray** — VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks с REALITY, TLS, WebSocket, gRPC и XHTTP; подписки, пакетные проверки и двухэтапный сканер чистых IP. - **WARP, MASQUE, WireGuard и WARP-в-WARP** (ядро Aether) с выбором страны выхода через NAT64, а также отдельный движок **WARP**. - **Amnezia** — бесплатные серверы AmneziaWG, WireGuard и Hysteria2, а там, где линия их блокирует, — через Cloudflare. - **FENIX** — бесплатный VPN Firefox на ваших собственных аккаунтах Firefox (33 страны, 50 ГБ в месяц на аккаунт). - Бесплатные серверы **Proton VPN** и **Windscribe** на ваших аккаунтах (все протоколы, через WARP там, где провайдер заблокирован), ключи **Outline**, **OpenVPN** (TunnelBear и бесплатные файлы `.ovpn`) и конфиги **NPV**. - **Psiphon**, **Tor** (с менеджером мостов, который проверяет мосты с вашей линии), **Geph**, **Lantern** и **URnetwork**. - **GitHub-туннель** — ваш собственный облачный сервер на бесплатной квоте аккаунта GitHub; **прокси Telegram** на вашем Cloudflare; **быстрое подключение**, иранские конфиги, обход фильтров SNI (с ECH) и domain fronting без сервера. ### Облако и инструменты - **Облачная панель** — подключение аккаунтов Cloudflare, развёртывание собственных панелей на Worker в одно нажатие, получение их конфигов и контроль дневного использования. - **Cloudflare Doctor** — находит, где обрывается ваше соединение с Cloudflare, пробуя десятки способов на вашей линии, и запоминает рабочий для каждой сети. - **Config Studio** — панель пользователей, трафика, сроков и лимитов устройств на вашем Worker, с многолокационными выходами, тарифами, шаблонами и точками подключения. - **MLM Scout** — реально проверяет каждый способ на вашей линии и ранжирует их. - **Game Booster** — измеряет маршрут до региона игры и выбирает лучший из вашей линии, WARP, Amnezia, WireGuard и FENIX; DNS против санкций для входа и плавающий пинг поверх игры. - **Умная маршрутизация Ирана**, раздельное туннелирование по приложениям и **общий доступ по локальной сети** (прокси, точка доступа и ссылка PAC для других устройств) на всех движках. - Главный экран в стиле iPhone с папками и поиском, виджеты главного экрана и **Widget Studio**, плитка быстрых настроек, **магазин** движков с подписанными обновлениями, резервное копирование и восстановление, обновление приложения изнутри. ### Структура проекта ``` app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/ ├── core/ # Низкоуровневые обёртки движков (aether, warp, tunnel) └── scanner/ ├── data/ # Управление данными узлов/подписок/облака ├── engines/ # Подключаемые движки (по папке на каждый) ├── mitm/ # CA на устройстве + профиль domain fronting без сервера ├── ui/ # Экраны Compose └── utils/ # Генераторы конфигов, тестеры, сторожевые таймеры app/src/main/assets/ # Скрипты воркеров, гео-данные, списки санкций app/src/main/jniLibs/ # Готовые нативные библиотеки ``` ### Сборка Требования: Android Studio (свежая версия), JDK под Android Gradle Plugin из `build.gradle` и Android SDK с `compileSdk 36`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git cd mlmvpn_android ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` Отладочный APK появится в `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/`. > Нативные библиотеки (файлы `.so` в `app/src/main/jniLibs/`) и файлы данных > (`geoip.dat`, `geosite.dat`) большие и хранятся в **Git LFS**. Установите > [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.com/) и после клонирования выполните `git lfs pull`. ### История изменений Полная история версий (на двух языках) — в [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) и на [**странице изменений**](https://mlmvpn.github.io/mlmvpn_android/changelog.html). ### Участие Мы рады вкладу — в [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) описаны структура проекта, правила оформления кода и добавление нового движка. ### Лицензия и указание авторства Проект распространяется под **GNU GPLv3** с дополнительным условием (разрешённым §7 GPLv3) об указании авторства — см. [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). В проект входит исходный код под GPL (`kittoku/mvc`, `shadowsocks-android` и Telegram for Android для интерфейса Gereh), поэтому всё совместное произведение распространяется под GPL. Кратко: > Любое использование, форк или производная работа — в исходном или > скомпилированном виде — должны явно указывать первоначального разработчика, > **mlmvpn** (https://github.com/mlmvpn), везде, где программа показывается > конечным пользователям (экран «О программе», README, страница в магазине и > т. д.), в дополнение к обычным обязательствам GPLv3 (доступность исходного > кода, та же лицензия для производных работ и т. д.). --- ## 中文 ### 概述 MLM VPN 在一个 iPhone 风格的主屏幕上集合了多个独立的连接引擎：V2Ray/Xray 客户端和干净 IP 扫描器、能自己找到可用路由的自适应引擎、二十多种面向受限网络 的连接方式、完整的 Cloudflare 控制面板，以及完全不需要服务器的通讯工具 **Gereh**。使用 Kotlin 和 Jetpack Compose 编写（`minSdk 24`、`targetSdk 34`、 `compileSdk 36`）。 > ⚠️ 本项目涉及网络规避和 VPN 技术。请遵守你所在地区的法律使用。维护者不鼓励 > 也不认可任何非法用途。 ### 语言 English、فارسی、**Русский** 和 **中文**（俄语和中文是 1.2.43 新增的：菜单、按钮 和提示已翻译，部分页面内的文字仍为英文）。在 设置 › 应用语言 中选择；Gereh 会 跟随该设置。 ### Gereh——手机到手机的通讯工具（1.2.43 新增） - **无服务器、无需手机号、无需邮箱。** 你的身份是在手机上生成的密钥，名字形如 `ehsan·4821`；消息直接从一部手机发到另一部手机。 - **端到端加密。** 每条消息、照片和文件都在发送者手机上密封，只在接收者手机上打开。 - **多种送达方式：** 共享 Wi-Fi（即使没有互联网）、近距离蓝牙、通过志愿者 （用户自己的手机和电脑）走互联网，以及 **Google 中继**——用户自己 Google 账户 中的一个小邮箱（Apps Script），用于无法互相联系的手机，例如一部使用 Irancell、 一部使用 MCI。所有者可以把中继作为**公共中继**向所有人开放；Google 和所有者 只能看到密封的字节。 - **文件分块传输：** 照片、视频、文件和语音消息被切成等大的块，可以通过任何 路径传递，包括中继。 - **群组和频道**，有所有者和管理员、设置和成员权限、邀请链接（可选审批）， 以及官方频道和群组「MLMVPN Official」，成员数在手机之间估算。 - 通过二维码或名片链接添加联系人，或用「添加附近的人」并核对 4 个符号。 支持通知、聊天文件夹和主屏幕小部件；Gereh 在独立进程中运行，其错误不会影响 VPN。 ### 连接引擎 - **FLUX**——独立的自适应引擎：同时竞速多条路由，可选择国家和 IP 版本，连接后 验证真实出口。 - **MAE（MLM Adaptive Engine）**——你选择常用的应用和网站；它针对每个网络学习 每个应用需要哪条路由，并在你自己的 Cloudflare 账户上建立境外出口（包括供 Gemini 和 Google Flow 使用的美国出口）。 - **V2Ray / Xray 客户端**——VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Shadowsocks，支持 REALITY、 TLS、WebSocket、gRPC 和 XHTTP；订阅、批量测试和两阶段干净 IP 扫描器。 - **WARP、MASQUE、WireGuard 和 WARP-in-WARP**（Aether 内核），可通过 NAT64 选择出口国家；另有独立的 **WARP** 引擎。 - **Amnezia**——免费的 AmneziaWG、WireGuard 和 Hysteria2 服务器，在线路封锁 它们的地方经由 Cloudflare。 - **FENIX**——在你自己的 Firefox 账户上使用 Firefox 的免费 VPN（33 个国家， 每个账户每月 50 GB）。 - 你自己账户上的 **Proton VPN** 和 **Windscribe** 免费服务器（所有协议，在 服务商被封锁时经由 WARP）、**Outline** 密钥、**OpenVPN**（TunnelBear 和免费 `.ovpn` 文件）以及 **NPV** 配置。 - **Psiphon**、**Tor**（带网桥管理器，从你的线路测试网桥）、**Geph**、 **Lantern** 和 **URnetwork**。 - **GitHub 隧道**——在你 GitHub 账户的免费额度上运行你自己的云服务器；你自己 Cloudflare 上的 **Telegram 代理**；**快速连接**、伊朗配置、SNI 反过滤（支持 ECH）和无服务器域前置。 ### 云与工具 - **云面板**——连接 Cloudflare 账户，一键部署自托管的 Worker 面板，获取其配置 并查看每日用量。 - **Cloudflare Doctor**——在你自己的线路上尝试几十种方式，找出你与 Cloudflare 的连接在哪里中断，并为每个网络记住可用的方式。 - **Config Studio**——在你自己的 Worker 上管理用户、流量、时间和设备限制的面板， 支持多位置出口、套餐、模板和端点。 - **MLM Scout**——在你的线路上真实测试每一种方式并排名。 - **Game Booster（游戏加速器）**——测量到游戏区域的路由，从你自己的线路、WARP、 Amnezia、WireGuard 和 FENIX 中选出最佳；提供用于登录的反制裁 DNS 和游戏上方 的悬浮 ping。 - 所有引擎都支持 **伊朗智能路由**、按应用分流和 **局域网共享**（为其他设备提供 代理、热点和 PAC 链接）。 - iPhone 风格的主屏幕（文件夹和搜索）、主屏幕小部件和 **Widget Studio**、快速 设置图块、带签名更新的引擎**商店**、备份与恢复，以及应用内软件更新。 ### 项目结构 ``` app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/ ├── core/ # 底层引擎封装（aether、warp、tunnel） └── scanner/ ├── data/ # 节点/订阅/云数据管理 ├── engines/ # 可插拔的连接引擎（每个一个目录） ├── mitm/ # 设备上的 CA + 无服务器域前置配置 ├── ui/ # Compose 界面 └── utils/ # 配置生成器、测试器、看门狗 app/src/main/assets/ # Worker 脚本、地理数据、制裁列表 app/src/main/jniLibs/ # 预编译的原生库 ``` ### 构建 要求：较新的 Android Studio、与 `build.gradle` 中 Android Gradle Plugin 匹配的 JDK，以及安装了 `compileSdk 36` 的 Android SDK。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git cd mlmvpn_android ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` 调试版 APK 位于 `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/`。 > 原生库（`app/src/main/jniLibs/` 下的 `.so` 文件）和数据文件（`geoip.dat`、 > `geosite.dat`）体积较大，使用 **Git LFS** 管理。克隆后请安装 > [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.com/) 并运行 `git lfs pull`。 ### 更新日志 完整的版本历史（双语）见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) 和 [**更新日志页面**](https://mlmvpn.github.io/mlmvpn_android/changelog.html)。 ### 参与贡献 欢迎贡献——项目结构、代码规范以及如何添加新引擎，请参阅 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ### 许可与署名 本项目采用 **GNU GPLv3** 许可，并附加一项署名条款（GPLv3 第 7 条允许）——见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。项目包含 GPL 源代码（`kittoku/mvc`、`shadowsocks-android`， 以及用于 Gereh 界面的 Telegram for Android），因此整个组合作品均为 GPL。简而言之： > 对本项目的任何使用、分叉或衍生作品——无论是源代码还是编译后的形式——都必须 > 在向最终用户展示软件的任何地方（关于页面、README、商店页面等）明确注明原始 > 开发者 **mlmvpn**（https://github.com/mlmvpn），同时遵守 GPLv3 的标准义务 > （提供源代码、衍生作品使用相同许可等）。

repositories.readme:
# Throne for Android **Android proxy client, powered by [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box)** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&label=release&color=2F80ED)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/total?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=downloads)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=stars)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&color=6E7781)](LICENSE) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-@ThroneProj-26A5E4?style=flat-square&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/ThroneProj)
Throne for Android manages proxy profiles and subscriptions, routes traffic with rule-based routing profiles, and works either as a VPN or as a proxy-only service. It shares [Throne](https://github.com/throneproj/Throne) desktop's core and data model, so profiles, share links, route profiles and `.thrbackup` backups move freely between the two. See the [documentation](https://throneproj.github.io) for guides.

## Installation APKs for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 are on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases), with a `SHA256SUMS` file to verify them. Throne runs on Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer, including Android TV. ### Upgrading from 1.x Releases from v2.0.0 on are signed with a new key, so Android refuses to install them over a 1.x release (signature conflict). Uninstall the old release first, then import your subscriptions and profiles again: old local configurations are not migrated. ## Supported protocols - SOCKS - HTTP(S) - Shadowsocks - Trojan - VMess - VLESS - TUIC - Hysteria - Hysteria2 - AnyTLS - Mieru - Snell - NaïveProxy - Juicity - TrustTunnel - ShadowTLS - Wireguard - AmneziaWG - MASQUE - SSH - DNSTT / VayDNS - MasterDNS - Xray VLESS (XHTTP/XDrive) - OpenVPN/OpenConnect - Custom Outbound (Both Sing-box and Xray) - Custom Config (Both Sing-box and Xray) - Chaining outbounds ## Subscription Formats Various formats are supported, including share links, various JSON representation of Sing-box configs, and v2rayN link format as well as limited support for Shadowsocks and Clash formats. Deeplinks are also supported, read the [documentation](https://throneproj.github.io/advanced/deeplinks/) for more information. ## Credits - [SagerNet/sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) - [XTLS/Xray-core](https://github.com/xtls/xray-core) - [SagerNet/sing-box-dashboard](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box-dashboard) - [MatsuriDayo/NekoBoxForAndroid](https://github.com/MatsuriDayo/NekoBoxForAndroid) - [SagerNet/SagerNet](https://github.com/SagerNet/SagerNet) - [shadowsocks/shadowsocks-android](https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-android) ## Supporting Throne If Throne is useful to you, you can support its development through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Mahdi-zarei) or with a crypto donation to one of these addresses: | Coin | Network | Address | |:--|:--|:--| | **USDT** · **TRX** | TRON (TRC20) | `THR2gbWMaTZh8ACk3VYAAyNRVffvdTRikj` | | **USDT** · **USDC** | BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) · Ethereum (ERC20) | `0x7c2dF1867f5AaEE807a835fB3c55E4de4507888A` | | **XMR** | Monero | `4AYwwN8qMQCSUb3XfwzfrLNPMHfDme6U7CmNtQY4idCF8GtHHLG68VA3iZK867ypuKFr8J7CjXiJ96eFUA2T6aLVRUbgY3A` |

Chat, get help, report bugs, and share feature ideas.



Nuvio TV for tvOS

A modern Apple TV media player for browsing catalogs and playing user-configured sources.
SwiftUI tvOS shell - catalog browsing - AetherEngine / MPVKit playback

Download the latest Apple TV `.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases), then sideload it with Xcode, Apple Configurator, or your preferred tool. See the release notes for known issues. > **AltStore / SideStore / Feather Source:** Add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json` · [Add to AltStore](altstore://source?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json) · [Add to SideStore](sidestore://source?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/main/apps.json) > **New beta alerts:** [Manage notifications](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/subscription) → choose **Custom → Releases**. ## Latest tvOS Beta **Beta 3.5.2** is the latest tvOS release. [Quick download (.ipa)](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/download/tvos-beta-3.5.2/NuvioTV-3.5.2-unsigned-release.ipa) · [Read the release notes](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/releases/tag/tvos-beta-3.5.2) · [Report a bug or suggest an idea](https://github.com/bobsupra/NuvioTVOS/issues/new/choose) The IPA requires a compatible tvOS development or sideloading signing workflow before installation. ### New in Beta 3.5.2 - **Plex Media Server Integration:** Connect your Plex Media Server directly to Apple TV with multi-user Plex Home support, intro/credits skip markers, Plex stream labels, and Top Shelf/Continue Watching sync. - **Unified Library "Servers" Tab:** Dedicated Servers tab inside Library aggregating Plex, Jellyfin, and SMB shares into one unified browsing interface. - **AI "Surprise Me" & "For You" Catalogs:** AI-curated discovery across Trakt, Simkl, AniList, and MAL watch history with customizable AI engines (Gemini Flash, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen). - **Episode Shuffle Play:** Shuffle TV show episodes effortlessly from the series Details view or in-player Episodes shelf. - **AIOStreams & JS Plugins:** Direct integration for AIOStreams scraper configurations and local execution of JavaScript add-on plugins. - **Ambient Mode Screen Saver:** Full-bleed cinematic backdrop screensaver with metadata highlights when idle. - **Estimated Finish Time & Stream Recommendations:** Real-time clock completion time in HUD, best stream badges, and stream name keyword filtering. - **Navigation, Stream Resolution & Stability Polish:** Canonical IMDb stream ID resolution from TMDB, source picker focus retention, Jellyfin rate-limit recovery, and Keychain isolation. ### Built-in Player Nuvio's free built-in **AetherEngine** is the default in Auto mode. **MPVKit** is the one-way fallback, and either engine can be selected in Settings. - **Playback:** Native tvOS and Siri Remote controls, precise seeking and resume, saved audio and subtitle tracks, audio delay, frame-rate and dynamic-range matching, direct HTTPS and HLS streams, and custom HTTP headers. - **Video:** HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, Dolby Vision P5/P8, experimental full Dolby Vision P7 FEL, and optional MetalFX upscaling of sub-1080p SDR toward the display's resolution, with VideoToolbox/Neural Engine super-resolution when supported on compatible devices running tvOS 27.1+. - **Audio:** Dolby Atmos passthrough (E-AC3+JOC), channel fold-down, night-mode compression, and up to +12 dB dialogue lift with peak limiting. The optional lossless audio bridge converts supported non-streamable surround audio (TrueHD, DTS-HD MA, Opus) to up to 7.1-channel LPCM (24-bit for lossless sources; lossy inputs may be 16-bit) for compatible AVRs and eARC soundbars. When disabled, multichannel audio is bridged to Dolby Digital Plus with up to 5.1 channels for ARC compatibility. - **Subtitles and seeking:** Embedded and add-on text/PGS subtitles, authored ASS/SSA through AetherEngine's custom renderer, and thumbnail previews while scrubbing. Optional Seekr storyboards provide extra preview frames when configured. MPVKit handles separate audio/video URLs, audio amplification, and complex ASS/SSA typesetting. For supported 48 kHz TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X VOD, **Settings → Playback → Player → Atmos & DTS:X Spatial Audio (Beta)** opts into a fixed 9.1.6 render on tvOS 26+. It is off by default. The engine delivers 24-bit PCM to the system for HDMI and AirPods Spatial Audio, or lossy APAC for AirPlay; this is not TrueHD or DTS-HD bitstream passthrough. See [the spatial audio notes](docs/truehd-spatial-audio.md) for supported sources and fallback behavior. ### Supported Media Servers & Sources [Plex](https://plex.tv) · [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org) · SMB (NAS / Network Shares) · [Usenet (NNTP)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usenet) · [AIOStreams](https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams) · [Stremio Add-ons](https://stremio.com) ### Supported Tracking Services [Trakt](https://trakt.tv) · [Simkl](https://simkl.com) · [AniList](https://anilist.co) · [MyAnimeList](https://myanimelist.net) · [WeTrakr](https://wetrakr.com) · [MDBList](https://mdblist.com) ### Notes - Content availability depends on your configured sources and their upstream services. - The Apple TV Simulator cannot play AV1. ## About This project began with the Nuvio mobile app as its foundation. Since then, the tvOS version has grown into one of the best user-configured media players for Apple TV: a native SwiftUI app with catalog browsing, profiles, search, library and watchlist features, and playback controls designed for the Siri Remote. The shared mobile code remains in [composeApp](./composeApp), alongside the iOS app in [iosApp](./iosApp). Active tvOS development happens in [tvosApp/NuvioTV](./tvosApp/NuvioTV). ## Current tvOS App Native SwiftUI Apple TV app with configurable catalogs; profile-scoped Nuvio libraries, Plex servers, Jellyfin libraries, and SMB shares; Calendar and follows; and Watch Party. Top Shelf supports configurable content in carousel, landscape, and poster layouts. Optional Seekr seek previews show frames near the playhead. Playback uses AetherEngine, with MPVKit for demanding cases; the app also supports native Usenet/NNTP playback. See the [tvOS source](./tvosApp/NuvioTV) and [Tuist project](./tvosApp/Project.swift). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Development Requires macOS, Xcode with an Apple TV simulator runtime, tvOS 18 or later, [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev) (tool version pinned in `mise.toml`), [Tuist](https://tuist.dev), and network access. The Xcode project is generated from [tvosApp/Project.swift](./tvosApp/Project.swift). Clone with submodules and generate the workspace: ```bash git clone --recurse-submodules NuvioTVOS cd NuvioTVOS mise install (cd tvosApp && tuist generate) ``` With an Apple TV simulator booted, run `./scripts/run-mobile.sh tvos s` or build the `NuvioTV` scheme in Xcode. ## Configuration & Tests Login is optional during development; the default Nuvio backend is configured for QR and email login. Unit tests are in [NuvioTVTests](./tvosApp/NuvioTVTests) and run with `scripts/test-tvos.sh`; UI tests use the separate `NuvioTV-UI` scheme. See the [UI validation notes](./tvosApp/NuvioTVUITests/README.md). ## Built With - SwiftUI and UIKit focus/input bridging for tvOS - AetherEngine and MPVKit playback engines - Configurable catalog, source, and subtitle APIs - Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform code from the original mobile app ## Legal & DMCA Nuvio functions solely as a client-side interface for browsing metadata and playing media provided by user-configured sources. It is intended for content the user owns or is otherwise authorized to access. Nuvio is not affiliated with any third-party extensions, catalogs, sources, or content providers. It does not host, store, or distribute any media content. For comprehensive legal information, including the full disclaimer, third-party extension policy, and DMCA/Copyright information, visit the [Legal & Disclaimer Page](https://nuvioapp.space/legal).

**Biome** is a performant toolchain for web projects, it aims to provide developer tools to maintain the health of said projects. **Biome is a [fast formatter](https://github.com/biomejs/benchmark#formatting)** for _JavaScript_, _TypeScript_, _JSX_, _JSON_, _CSS_, _GraphQL_, _HTML_, _Markdown_, _YAML_, and _SCSS_ that scores **[97% compatibility with _Prettier_](https://algora.io/challenges/prettier)**. **Biome is a [performant linter](https://github.com/biomejs/benchmark#linting)** for _JavaScript_, _TypeScript_, _JSX_, _JSON_, _CSS_, _GraphQL_, _HTML_, _Markdown_, _YAML_, and _SCSS_ that features **[more than 750 rules](https://biomejs.dev/linter/javascript/rules/)** from ESLint, typescript-eslint, and [other sources](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/discussions/3). It **outputs detailed and contextualized diagnostics** that help you to improve your code and become a better programmer! **Biome** is designed from the start to be used [interactively within an editor](https://biomejs.dev/editors/first-party-extensions/). It can format and lint malformed code as you are writing it. ### Installation ```shell npm install --save-dev --save-exact @biomejs/biome ``` ### Usage ```shell # format files npx @biomejs/biome format --write # lint files and apply the safe fixes npx @biomejs/biome lint --write # run format, lint, etc. and apply the safe fixes npx @biomejs/biome check --write # check all files against format, lint, etc. in CI environments npx @biomejs/biome ci ``` If you want to give Biome a run without installing it, use the [online playground](https://biomejs.dev/playground/), compiled to WebAssembly. ## Documentation Check out our [homepage][biomejs] to learn more about Biome, or directly head to the [Getting Started guide][getting-started] to start using Biome. ## More about Biome **Biome** has sane defaults and it doesn't require configuration. **Biome** aims to support [all main languages][language-support] of modern web development. **Biome** [doesn't require Node.js](https://biomejs.dev/guides/manual-installation/) to function. **Biome** has first-class LSP support, with a sophisticated parser that represents the source text in full fidelity and top-notch error recovery. **Biome** wants to offer a high-quality _Developer Experience_, with descriptive diagnostics and great performance. **Biome** unifies functionalities that have previously been separate tools. Building upon a shared base allows us to provide a cohesive experience for processing code, displaying errors, parallelize work, caching, and configuration. Read more about our [project philosophy][biome-philosophy]. **Biome** is [MIT licensed](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/tree/main/LICENSE-MIT) or [Apache 2.0 licensed](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/tree/main/LICENSE-APACHE) and moderated under the [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/tree/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). ## Funding You can fund the project in different ways ### Project sponsorship and funding You can sponsor or fund the project via [Open collective](https://opencollective.com/biome) or [GitHub sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/biomejs) Biome offers a simple sponsorship program that allows companies to get visibility and recognition among various developers. Biome offers [enterprise support](https://biomejs.dev/enterprise), where Core Contributors can be employed to work on company-focused projects. ## Sponsors ### Platinum Sponsors

repositories.readme:
# Unciv - Civ V remake for Android & Desktop

![](/extraImages/GithubPreviewImage.jpg)

[![Google Play](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=Google&message=Play&logo=google-play)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unciv.app)
[![F-Droid](https://img.shields.io/f-droid/v/com.unciv.app?logo=f-droid)](https://f-droid.org/en/packages/com.unciv.app/)
[![itch.io](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=itch.io&message=Unciv&color=607D8B&logo=itch.io)](https://yairm210.itch.io/unciv)
[![Flathub](https://img.shields.io/flathub/v/io.github.yairm210.unciv?logo=flathub)](https://flathub.org/apps/details/io.github.yairm210.unciv)
[![AUR](https://img.shields.io/aur/version/unciv-bin?logo=arch-linux)](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/unciv-bin)
[![pi-apps](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?color=c51a4a&label=Pi-Apps&logo=raspberry-pi&query=%24.Unciv.Version&url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FBotspot%2Fpi-apps-analytics%2Fmain%2Fpackage_data_v2.json)](https://github.com/Botspot/pi-apps)
![Brew](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fformulae.brew.sh%2Fapi%2Fformula%2Funciv.json&query=%24.versions.stable&logo=homebrew&label=Brew)
[![Chocolatey](https://img.shields.io/chocolatey/v/unciv?logo=chocolatey)](https://community.chocolatey.org/packages/unciv)
[![scoop-games](https://img.shields.io/scoop/v/unciv?bucket=games)](https://github.com/Calinou/scoop-games)
 
[![Build status](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/actions/workflows/buildAndTest.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/actions/workflows/buildAndTest.yml)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/586194543280390151?color=%237289DA&logo=discord&logoColor=%23FFFFFF)](https://discord.gg/bjrB4Xw)


## What is this?

An open source, moddability-focused Android and Desktop remake of Civ V, made with [LibGDX](https://github.com/libgdx/libgdx).

## Is this any good?

Depends what you're looking for. If you're in the market for high-res graphics, amazing soundtracks, animations etc, I highly recommend Firaxis's Civ-V-like game, "Civilization V".

If you want a small, fast, moddable, FOSS, in-depth 4X that can still run on a potato, you've come to the right place :)

## How do I install?

- **Android** - [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unciv.app) or [F-droid](https://f-droid.org/en/packages/com.unciv.app/)
- **Linux** - [itch.io](https://yairm210.itch.io/unciv), Flatpak via [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/details/io.github.yairm210.unciv), or [AUR](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/unciv-bin)
- **Windows** - [Grab the MSI](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/releases/latest/download/Unciv.msi), or get from [itch.io](https://yairm210.itch.io/unciv), [Chocolatey](https://community.chocolatey.org/packages/unciv), or [Scoop](https://github.com/Calinou/scoop-games)
- **Raspberry Pi** - [Pi-apps](https://github.com/Botspot/pi-apps)
- **MacOS** - Via [Brew](https://brew.sh/) (`brew update && brew install unciv`) or install [with this guide](https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Other/Installing-on-macOS/) 
- Jars, APKs and Windows/Linux builds also available in [Releases](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/releases) (run jar with `java -jar Unciv.jar`) - *not recommended* since we update frequently and you will quickly become out-of-date
- [Build from scratch](https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Developers/Building-Locally/#without-android-studio) if that's your thing

## What's the roadmap?

In this order:

* Polish!
    * UI+UX improvements ([suggestions welcome!](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/issues/new?assignees=&labels=feature&template=feature_request.md&title=Feature+request%3A+))
    * Better automation, AI etc. in-game
* G&K mechanics - see [#4697](https://www.github.com/yairm210/Unciv/issues/4697)
* BNW mechanics - trade routes, world congress, etc.

At the moment, no one is explicitly working to add these mechanics in - you could be the one! :D

## Contributing

Programmers start [here](https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Developers/Building-Locally/)!

Translators start [here](https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Translating/Translating/)! Language completion status [here](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/blob/master/android/assets/jsons/translations/completionPercentages.properties) 

Modders start [here](https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Modders/Mods/)!

You can join us in any of the open issues, or work on improving anything you want - once you're finished, issue a pull request and it'll go into the next version!

If not, you can help by spreading the word - vote for Unciv where you can, mention it on Reddit or Twitter etc, and help us with new ideas of how to get the word out!


## FAQ

### How about iOS?

I'm not planning on it. It means paying money to Apple, yet another release path, and since I don't have an iOS device it means I can't test it properly.

### Steam release?

Steam has decided that they don't want to host Unciv, they probably don't want to risk legal issues with Firaxis (although those should be non-existent, see below).
 
### Will you implement {feature}?

If it's in the original Civ V, then yes!

If not, then the feature won't be added to the base game - possibly it will be added as a way to mod the game, which is constantly expanding.

#### Why not? This is its own game, why not add features that weren't in Civ V?

Having a clear vision is important for actually getting things done.

Anyone can make a suggestion. Not all are good, viable, or simple. Not many can actually implement stuff.

As an open source project, this stuff is done in our spare time, of which there isn't much.

We need a clear-cut criteria to decide what to work on and what not to work on.

#### Will you implement Civ VI?

Considering how long it took to get this far, no.

### How can I learn to play? Where's the wiki?

All the tutorial information is available in-game at menu > civilopedia > tutorials

All the information is included in the amazing [Civ V wiki](https://civilization.fandom.com/wiki/)

Since this is a Civ V clone, you can search Google for how to play Civ V and there are loads of answers =)

Alternatively, you could [join us on Discord](https://discord.gg/bjrB4Xw) and ask there =D

### Aren't you basically making a Civ V clone? Is that even legal?

According to the [US Copyright Office FL-108](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/96/U.S._Copyright_Office_fl108.pdf), intellectual property rights *do not* apply to mechanics - as I'm sure you know, there are a billion Flappy Bird knockoffs.

It is definitely illegal:
 - To use any assets from the original game (images, sound etc) - they belong to Firaxis

It is probably illegal (no solid sources on this):
 - To use the Civilization name
 - To impersonate the Civ games (so calling yourself civi|zation with a similar logo, for instance)

Interestingly, [Civilization is a registered trademark](https://tsdr.uspto.gov/#caseNumber=74166752&caseType=SERIAL_NO&searchType=statusSearch), but it looks like it's only *that particular logo* which is trademarked, so technically you could make another game called "Civilization" and it'll stick. In any case we're not going there :) 

## Run with Docker [![Docker](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/actions/workflows/dockerPublish.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/actions/workflows/dockerPublish.yml)

`docker run -d -p 6901:6901 -p 5901:5901 ghcr.io/yairm210/unciv`
Then go to http://localhost:6901/vnc.html?password=headless

For more details, e.g. installing Docker, keeping saves between runs and over image updates, building the image yourself,
troubleshooting connection issues, or using a native VNC client instead of a browser, see [Building-Locally](https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Developers/Building-Locally/#running-via-docker).

## Licensing and credits

Unciv's source code is available under the Mozilla Public License 2.0
(see [LICENSE](LICENSE)), except where otherwise noted.
TextureArraySpriteBatch.java, forked from
[carlislefox/libgdx-texture-array-batch](https://github.com/carlislefox/libgdx-texture-array-batch),
is available under CC0 1.0 Universal
(see [LICENSE-TextureArraySpriteBatch](LICENSE-TextureArraySpriteBatch)).

The media files are authored by many people and are available under a mix of
CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY 3.0/4.0, CC0, and public domain terms
(see [docs/Credits.md](docs/Credits.md)).

repositories.readme: # Erigon [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-up-green)](https://docs.erigon.tech/) [![Blog](https://img.shields.io/badge/blog-up-green)](https://erigon.tech/blog/) [![Twitter](https://img.shields.io/twitter/follow/ErigonEth?style=social)](https://x.com/ErigonEth) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join-5865F2?style=flat&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://dsc.gg/erigon) [![Build status](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/actions/workflows/ci-gate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/actions/workflows/ci-gate.yml) Erigon is an implementation of Ethereum (execution layer with embeddable consensus layer), on the efficiency frontier. **[Download](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/releases)** | [Documentation](https://docs.erigon.tech/) | [Blog](https://erigon.tech/blog/) This README is for people working on the repository. Everything about operating a node — install methods, flags, pruning modes, ports, monitoring, staking — is on the documentation site. Documentation ============= The [Erigon documentation](https://docs.erigon.tech/) answers most questions. Useful starting points: * [Installation](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/installation) — binaries, Docker, Linux/macOS, Windows, ARM * [Hardware requirements](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/hardware-requirements) — disk, RAM, CPU, bandwidth * [Pruning modes](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/pruning-modes) — `archive`, `full`, `blocks`, `minimal` * [CLI reference](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/configuring-erigon) — every flag, config files, env vars * [Default ports](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/default-ports) and [Security](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/security) * [Interacting with Erigon](https://docs.erigon.tech/interacting-with-erigon) — JSON-RPC, GraphQL, gRPC namespaces * [Creating a dashboard](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/creating-a-dashboard) — Prometheus and Grafana * [Upgrading](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/installation/upgrading) — versions and snapshot formats In-depth links are marked by the microscope sign (🔬) Usage ===== ### Erigon3 changes from Erigon2 - **Initial sync doesn't re-exec from 0:** downloading 99% LatestState and History - **Per-Transaction granularity of history** (Erigon2 had per-block). Means: - Can execute 1 historical transaction - without executing it's block - If account X change V1->V2->V1 within 1 block (different transactions): `debug_getModifiedAccountsByNumber` return it - Erigon3 doesn't store Logs (aka Receipts) - it always re-executing historical txn (but it's cheaper) - **Validator mode**: added. `--internalcl` is enabled by default. to disable use `--externalcl`. - **Store most of data in immutable files (segments/snapshots):** - can symlink/mount latest state to fast drive and history to cheap drive - `chaindata` is tens of gb (22gb on an archive mainnet node). It's ok to `rm -rf chaindata`. (to prevent grow: recommend `--batchSize <= 1G`) - **`--prune` flags changed**: see `--prune.mode` (default: `full`, archive: `archive`, EIP-4444: `minimal`) - **Other changes:** - ExecutionStage included many E2 stages: stage_hash_state, stage_trie, log_index, history_index, trace_index - Restart doesn't loose much partial progress: `--sync.loop.block.limit=5_000` enabled by default ### Logging Log flags, log levels and log files: [Logs](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/logs) and the [CLI reference](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/configuring-erigon). #### Torrent client logging The torrent client in the Downloader keeps its own file, `logs/torrent.log`. It is written at whichever is **more verbose** of `--torrent.verbosity` and `WARN`, so warnings and errors always reach it even at the default verbosity. Messages at `--torrent.verbosity` or above are additionally forwarded to Erigon's own file and console loggers, which emit them only if `--log.dir.verbosity` and `--verbosity` are themselves verbose enough. ### Block Production (PoS Validator) Block production is fully supported for Ethereum & Gnosis Chain. ### Beacon Chain (Consensus Layer) Erigon can be used as an Execution Layer for external Consensus Layer clients. See [JWT secret](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/jwt) and [Ethereum with an external CL](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/easy-nodes/how-to-run-an-ethereum-node/ethereum-with-an-external-cl). ### Caplin Caplin is Erigon's embedded Consensus Layer, enabled by default. Flags, archival modes and Beacon API configuration: [Caplin](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/caplin) and [Caplin for staking](https://docs.erigon.tech/staking/caplin). Why a new Consensus Layer rather than the Engine API: the Engine API delivers blocks one at a time, which does not suit Erigon's bulk model — Erigon is built to handle many blocks simultaneously and to sort and process data in batches. Owning the consensus layer lets Erigon drive block handling on its own terms instead of being paced by the Engine API. ### Dev Chain 🔬 Detailed explanation is [DEV_CHAIN](/docs/DEV_CHAIN.md). For developers ============== ### Building Toolchain: [Go >= 1.26](https://golang.org/doc/install), GCC 11+ or Clang 13+, 64-bit architecture. On Linux, kernel > v4. On x86-64 the build targets the `x86-64-v2` baseline (requires SSE4.2, POPCNT). Intel Nehalem (2008) and AMD Bulldozer (2011) or newer qualify; older hardware is not supported. ```sh git clone https://github.com/erigontech/erigon.git cd erigon make erigon ``` Binaries land in `./build/bin`. Use `-j` to parallelise the build. Packaged binaries, Docker images and the per-platform install steps are on the [installation](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/installation) page; to build a specific release rather than `main`, check out its tag. On Windows, build natively (Chocolatey, MinGW, and the MinGW anti-virus false-positive workaround) or under WSL2: [Native compilation](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/installation/#install-native) and [WSL](https://docs.erigon.tech/get-started/installation/#install-wsl). ### Executables `make erigon` builds the node; `make all` builds the full suite into `./build/bin`. `make help` lists every target. | Command | Description | |--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | `erigon` | The node: execution layer with the embedded consensus layer (Caplin) | | `rpcdaemon` | JSON-RPC server; runs in-process or standalone against a local or remote Erigon | | `sentry` | The p2p layer as an independent process | | `txpool` | The transaction pool as an independent process | | `downloader` | Snapshot downloader, and verification of webseed metainfos against the preverified set | | `integration`| Sync-stage and datadir maintenance tool — see [cmd/integration/Readme.md](./cmd/integration/Readme.md) | | `evm` | Standalone EVM for running bytecode, disassembling and full trace logs | | `mcp` | Standalone MCP server for Erigon | `caplin`, `capcli`, `snapshots`, `rpctest` and `pics` are also built by `make all`. ### Testing ```sh make test-short # fast unit tests make test-all # full test suite make test-fixtures-cl # consensus-spec fixtures (also: test-fixtures-eest, test-fixtures-zkevm) make lint # run before opening or updating a PR ``` [docs/TESTING.md](./docs/TESTING.md) covers the release-time incremental-sync verification, which is a separate exercise from the test suite above. ### Use as library ``` # please use git branch name (or commit hash). don't use git tags go get github.com/erigontech/erigon@main go mod tidy ``` ### Repository docs - [docs/DEV_CHAIN.md](./docs/DEV_CHAIN.md) — dev chain / local devnet - [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) — how the services are wired when run as separate processes - [db/etl/README.md](./db/etl/README.md) — the ETL framework used to preprocess data before DB inserts - [db/downloader/README.md](./db/downloader/README.md) — snapshot downloader internals - [cmd/downloader/readme.md](./cmd/downloader/readme.md) — snapshots overview: what they are, when they are created and pulled - [cmd/rpcdaemon/README.md](./cmd/rpcdaemon/README.md) — RPC daemon, including running it remotely - [cmd/prometheus/Readme.md](./cmd/prometheus/Readme.md) — metrics and dashboards - [CI-GUIDELINES.md](./CI-GUIDELINES.md) — read before changing workflows ### JSON-RPC daemon Most of Erigon's components (txpool, rpcdaemon, snapshots downloader, sentry, ...) can run inside Erigon or as independent processes. Deployment modes, flags and remote (Remote DB) setup: [RPC Daemon](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/modules/rpc-daemon) and [cmd/rpcdaemon/README.md](./cmd/rpcdaemon/README.md). ### Default Ports and Firewalls Every default port, the flags that change them, and firewalling guidance: [Default ports](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/default-ports) and [Security](https://docs.erigon.tech/fundamentals/security). #### Hetzner expecting strict firewall rules Ports to open and the reserved IPv4 ranges to block: [Hetzner firewall note](https://docs.erigon.tech/help-center/troubleshooting#hetzner-cloud--dedicated-server-firewall-note). ### Run as a separate user - `systemd` example Running erigon from `build/bin` as a separate user requires the binaries to be *installed* using `make DIST= install`. You could use `$HOME/erigon` or `/opt/erigon` as the installation path, for example: ```sh make DIST=/opt/erigon install ``` ### Grab diagnostic for bug report - Get stack trace: `kill -SIGUSR1 `, get trace and stop: `kill -6 ` - Get CPU profiling: add `--pprof` flag and run `go tool pprof -png http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/profile\?seconds\=20 > cpu.png` - Get RAM profiling: add `--pprof` flag and run `go tool pprof -inuse_space -png http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/heap > mem.png` ### Run local devnet 🔬 Detailed explanation is [here](/docs/DEV_CHAIN.md). ### How to change db pagesize [post](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/blob/main/cmd/integration/Readme.md#copy-data-to-another-db) Getting in touch ================ ### Reporting security issues/concerns Report vulnerabilities privately via [Security → Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/security/advisories/new). Please don't open a public issue for one — see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md). ### Getting help * [Discord](https://dsc.gg/erigon) for community support and development chat * [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/issues) to report a bug — see [Grab diagnostic for bug report](#grab-diagnostic-for-bug-report) first * [Release notes](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/releases) for what changed in each version License ======= Erigon is licensed under the [GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0](./COPYING).
